statement: A Pendulum Monster can be Pendulum Summoned from the hand, and from the Extra Deck while face-up there; a Fusion, Synchro, Xyz or Link Pendulum Monster only from the Extra Deck. One whose text says it must be Special Summoned a way of its own isn't Pendulum Summoned.

sources.says: A Pendulum Summon Special Summons monsters from the hand and face-up Pendulum Monsters from the Extra Deck whose Levels are between the two Pendulum Scales.

sources.by: Claude (the reader's reading for Extra Deck Pendulum Monsters and those with a Summon of their own, which ocgcore agrees with)

scripts: ocgcore applies it. Sangan's RML read from the scripts gave every Pendulum Monster a Pendulum Summon from the hand, Patissciel Couverture included.
